salary: The notified posts carry a pay scale of Rs. 24,280-72,850 .
age_limit: For Post Codes 21 to 23, 25, 26, 27 and 28 , the prescribed basic age requirement is 18 to below 22 years as on 01 July 2026 . || However, the Government of Telangana has provided an additional relaxation of 5 years in the upper age limit for direct recruitment to uniformed services, including Police, Fire Services, Prisons and Special Protection Force Departments. || Further category-wise and special-category age relaxations apply as prescribed in the official notification. Candidates should check the age conditions applicable to their category before applying.
application_fee: The application fee amount will be determined through the TSLPRB online application system based on the post or posts selected by the candidate. || OC and BC candidates with Telangana local status have to pay the fee designated in the online application. Local SC and ST candidates of Telangana will pay the applicable concessional fee. Other candidates must pay the fee designated by the online application system. || Candidates applying for multiple eligible posts may receive the applicable fee rebate as prescribed in the notification. || The application fee can be paid using Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking or other payment methods made available on the TSLPRB website . Fee once paid will not be refunded.
selection_process: The TSLPRB Police Constable selection process includes written examinations, physical tests and certificate verification. Candidates must qualify at the applicable stages of the recruitment process. || Preliminary Written Test (PWT) || Physical Measurement Test (PMT) || Physical Efficiency Test (PET) || Final Written Examination (FWE) || Certificate Verification || Final Selection as per the applicable post-wise merit criteria
